d:
Bihar Teachers New Rule : bihar ke sarkari vidyalyon men ab shikshakon ke lie aupcharik dres pahanna anivary hoga. shiksha mantri ki pahal par shiksha vibhag ke apar mukhy sachiv ne is sanbandh men nirdesh jari kie hain. nae nirdesh ke bad skulon men shikshakon ke pahnave ko lekar sakhti dekhne ko mil sakti hai.
Aakhir shikshakon ke lie kya hoga naya dres kod? vibhag ke is phaisle ka skulon par kya asar parega? janie is riport men.
Bihar ki shiksha vyavastha se juri har bari khabar aur apdet ke lie hamare chainal ko sabsakraib karen.
